background_notes.fact: For an F0-linear subspace W0 of U0 and a family uvec:Fin(n0)→U0 whose members all lie in W0, span_F0(range uvec) is contained in W0. Thus span_F0(range uvec)=U0 implies W0=U0.

grounds.reason: W0 is an F0-linear subspace of U0 under the local hypotheses.
F003 asserts that every member of uvec belongs to W0.
The correctly instantiated M002 gives span_F0(range uvec)=U0.

background_notes.justification: Every finite F0-linear combination of members of uvec lies in W0 by closure under scalar multiplication, addition and zero. These finite linear combinations form their linear span. Hence U0 is contained in W0 when that span is U0; the reverse inclusion holds because W0 is a subspace of U0.
